# Luxfer Announces Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results


### 28 October 2026


**LUXFER REPORTS THIRD QUARTER RESULTS**


**Third Quarter 2026 Highlights***


-


**GAAP Net Sales of $91.7 million, compared to $95.6 million in the prior-year period; Adjusted Net Sales¹ declined 3.9% to $89.3 million.**


-


**GAAP Net income of $0.9 million, or $0.03 per diluted share, compared to net income of $2.7 million, or $0.10 per diluted share, in the prior-year period.**


-


**Adjusted EBITDA¹ of $12.2 million, declined 10.3% compared to $13.6 million in the prior-year period**


-


**Adjusted Diluted EPS¹ of $0.25, declined 16.7% compared to $0.30.**


-


**Free Cash Flow of $12.4 million during the quarter, with net debt declining to $37.8 million**


*GAAP Measures now include the Superform business, previously reported as a discontinued operation.*


** Comparative information is relative to prior-year third quarter.*


*1 Note: Adjusted results exclude Superform and Graphic Arts businesses.*


**RIVERSIDE, CA, October 28, 2026** -- Business Wire -- Luxfer Holdings PLC (NYSE: LXFR) (“Luxfer” or the “Company”), a global industrial company innovating niche applications in materials engineering, today announced financial results for the Third quarter 2026.


In light of the pending transaction, Luxfer will not host an investor conference call or webcast to discuss its third quarter 2026 financial results.
